verdict.rationale: The Devin CLI docs mention a permission system with access controls at multiple levels covering both built-in and MCP tools, which implies tool approvals are configurable. Devin Review Auto-Fix also lets Devin act on review comments and CI failures without manual confirmation. Neither source says you can switch the agent to auto-approve every action. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an auto-approve, allow-all or 'yolo' permission mode; details on how to set allow rules for all tools; hands-on or independent corroboration.
